additional_concerns: Both constant-true formulas encode activation only under the stipulated independent-footnote reading. They do not resolve whether paragraph 14's request condition carries into footnote 5; the request-conditioned rival remains unresolved.

TRUE_IS_SATISFIED must refer only to the typed activation question. Neither formula establishes completed demonstration, compliance, SFC satisfaction, high-confidence assurance, or overdue performance.

The complete paragraphs 10–13 and footnote 2 are not supplied. The ownership-record and operational-compatibility provision supplies some substantive content, but cannot establish the complete demonstration standard.

Section 6.11C concerns outsourced valuation. Its supervision standard cannot automatically be imported into tokenisation duties. Likewise, intermediary paragraph 13 is not established as the paragraph 13 incorporated by footnote 5.

Paragraph 15 retains its own request condition for third-party audit or verification. Paragraph 16 independently conditions procurement of a legal opinion on request; neither procurement requirement becomes unconditional under the proposed footnote reading.
The supplied structural and retrieval checks establish neither legal support for the independent reading nor actual scope classification.
